newsitem.title: USA: Martin Marietta in talks to sell quarry.
newsitem.headline: Martin Marietta in talks to sell quarry.

text.p: Martin Marietta Materials Inc said Thursday it is negotiating the sale of one quarry in Indianapolis as part of a proposed consent agreement with the U.S. Department of Justice.

The company also said it has completed the purchase of all outstanding common stock of American Aggregates Corp, along with certain other assets from CSR America Inc, at a cash price of $229.7 million.
The purchase includes all of American Aggregates quarry operations in Indiana and Ohio but excludes Michigan operations, Martin Marietta said.

Martin Marietta's existing operations in Illinois and Indiana will be combined with the acquired operations to form a new business unit called the MidAmerica Division, which includes 37 quarries in Ohio, Indiana and Illinois, the company said.
The Justice Dept said the company's presence in the Indianapolis area was too strong and told them to sell one quarry, Martin Marietta president Stephen Zelnak Jr said.
